notes: The and of to and fro is kept inside שׁוּט's one rendering under rule 14's closing sentence rather than marked added.
נָא is rendered here by now rather than by an entreaty formula; the word is aligned as written (rule 30).
The waw before עַד takes the bare even and the עַד takes to alone, as rule 16 directs where a conjunction stands beside the limit preposition.
